_comment: The dev area: a small level rectangle to try mechanics without the finished ship. Area frame: x east, y north; the mini ship in the south half (crates/exo_app/src/dev_area/layout.rs), the open role zones in the north half (dev_area/mod.rs), the pad 'main' east of the ship, where the flight ship parks; `--start=dev_area` puts the walker in the mini ship. On open dry land on Hearth near the equator (the noise ground there varies by under a metre over the rectangle). Position and sizes are starting values (TODO(initiator)).
